customerNumber.title: customerNumber
customerNumber.description: The customer number of the company asking, format C-1234 (for example C-1001). Always ask the user for it. Never guess it, and never reuse a customer number from earlier in the conversation for a different company.

orderNumber.title: orderNumber
orderNumber.description: The order number, format SO-12345. Always ask the user for it. Never guess it.
